body:
Independent review pass 1 (monitoring loop) on the statistical/brain-scale umbrella.

VERIFIED - Epic 2 component law is correct. I re-derived and numerically checked K_coh = a a^T/(a^T K^-1 a), K_cfg = K - K_coh:
  - K_coh rank 1 PSD; K_cfg PSD rank k-1 (K^-1/2 K_cfg K^-1/2 = I - uu^T/||u||^2, so eigenvalues are {1 x (k-1), 0})
  - K_coh + K_cfg = K exactly
  - K = D(w), a = w/sum(w) gives K_coh = w w^T/sum(w); effect form matches the existing first-moment path (kernel.R:697-703) to 5.6e-16, cross-partition included
  - K = Sigma^-1 keeps the coherent amplitude at the RAW regional mean B a with energy divided by a^T Sigma a (a squared-t)
This is a genuine solution to the raw-vs-whitened coherent tension. Recommend keeping it.

TWO GAPS FILED

bd-01KZXBD69V5PFTKTVBXDNKZT7J (p0, metrics/semantics/laws) - Frame-metric composition is undefined. Once K is general, a support carries both W_x. and K_x and no epic says how they compose. Epic 2 fixes a = w/sum(w), which presumes the frame still carries weights; Epic 4's support-streamed lowering does not say what happens to W. Knock-on: the documented conservative-normalization conservation law (README: local total geometries sum to global geometry) requires sum_x pad(K_x) = K_global, which is false for local precisions. That claim needs the same capability gate Epic 8 already applies to the searchlight-cost claim.

bd-01KZXBDP92BNX44VWW08M35VQZ (p1, metrics/components/performance) - The component law needs a^T K^-1 a and no operator contract exposes it. For precision recipes this is a^T Sigma_hat a, free before inversion; against an apply-K-only handle it becomes an O(k^3) factorization per support per edge, on top of what Epic 1 already projects.

No objection to the rest of the decomposition - Epics 3, 4, 5, 8 already cover the separable-model capability, the pair-atom materialization ban, calibration-vs-estimated-metric, and the README searchlight-cost claim. Epic 6 correctly does not depend on Epic 5.
